flows: Navigate to http://127.0.0.1:4312/#HelloThere then In the sidebar on the right side of the page, click the plus icon button (its tooltip says 'Create a new tiddler'). An edit form opens with a title box that says 'New Tiddler'. Leave the title as it is. Click inside the large empty text area below the title and tags and type exactly this on one line: Jump to spot and Landing place . Then click the tick (checkmark) button at the top right of that edit form (its tooltip says 'Confirm changes to this tiddler'). Scroll to the tiddler titled 'New Tiddler' if it is not in view. Is this true right now: "A tiddler titled 'New Tiddler' is shown, not in edit mode, with the link 'Jump to spot' followed by the text 'and Landing place'."? Store exactly yes or no as 'ready'. In the body of the tiddler titled 'New Tiddler', click the link 'Jump to spot' once. Wait 2 seconds. Do not scroll or click anything else. Then stop.
